desc: The original fastest bore cleaner on the planet has a new home. Hoppe's BoreSnake® Den™ is a compact carrying case with a built in handle for easy storage between firearm cleanings. It conveniently fits in a range bag or backpack to protect your Boresnake brushes during transport. The lid of the Snake Den™ doubles as convenient pull handle that snaps into the clear case for storage. A one pass solution, BoreSnake® uses an integrated bronze brush to scrub out carbon fouling, while the tail clears the barrel of loose debris with a surface area 160x larger than a standard patch.
